method.minimumBattles: Independent 0-1 shortest path within the same layer, from its entrance to its fire node; entering a battle node costs 1 and all other nodes cost 0. Does not call minimumBattlesTo.
method.excluded: Event-triggered battles, boss battles, combat outcome, card costs, and browser play.
method.snapshot: createMapSnapshot -> planMapRestore at layer 3 entrance -> createMapSnapshot; serialized snapshots must match and original input must remain unchanged.
